# IamLogic

> IamLogic is an enterprise identity security provider offering Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) and Identity & Access Management (IAM) solutions. Its solutions support identity lifecycle management, Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) automation, provisioning and deprovisioning, access requests, access certification, role management, Segregation of Duties (SoD), SSO, MFA, passwordless authentication and compliance reporting across modern, legacy and hybrid environments.

## Project Details

- Website: [IamLogic](https://iamlogic.com/)
- Organization: IamLogic
- Organization Type: Enterprise Identity Security Software Provider
- Industry: Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) and Identity & Access Management (IAM)
- Primary Language: English
- Country: India
- Headquarters: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- Website Type: Business Website

## Identity Governance and Administration

IamLogic provides Identity Governance & Administration capabilities for governing identities, managing access and supporting identity lifecycle processes.

Key areas include:

- Identity lifecycle management
- Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) automation
- Provisioning and deprovisioning
- Access requests
- Access certification
- Role management
- Segregation of Duties (SoD)
- Compliance reporting

## Identity and Access Management

IamLogic provides Identity & Access Management capabilities for securing authentication and managing access across modern, legacy and hybrid environments.

Key areas include:

- Single Sign-On (SSO)
- Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
- Passwordless authentication
- Access management
- Identity lifecycle management
